Sample.evidence_source: [/page/0/Text/12] Thirty participants, in Grades 7 through 12, were recruited through mental health and social services agencies, schools, hospitals, and media announcements of a self-help program for adolescent depression.
Sample.warning: Total recruited N is 30, but gender breakdown is only provided for the 22 participants who completed the study.

male_pct.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/2] The sample consisted of 8 boys and 14 girls.
male_pct.warning: Gender breakdown (8 boys, 14 girls) is provided for the 22 participants who completed the study, not the initial 30 recruited.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/0/Text/12] Inclusion criteria were a score of 10 or higher on the Child Depression Inventory (CDI; Kovacs, 1981), a score of 10 or higher on the Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression (HRSD; Hamilton, 1960)
